title: Achievements - Bannari Amman Institute of Technology
content: Bannari Amman Institute of Technology Institute Bannari Amman Institute of Technology is an Autonomous, Self-financing Engineering College, Approved by AICTE, New Delhi and Affiliated to Anna University, Chennai. Nestled on the banks of The River Bhavani, BIT campus provides environment for learning in harmony with nature, away from the odds of the city life. The spacious and the earth hugging buildings punctuated with landscaped courtyards and pathways are designed to emphasise the business ethics and or characteristics of an excellent centre for learning. The Campus hosts well planned academic blocks, computer centres, lecture halls, libraries, laboratories, conference halls, staff quarters, hostels and students' centres. The Campus also houses a co-operative store, ATM (Axis, SBI and KVB) and a clinic to attend to the general health of the students and staff. Training and Placement The training and placement team believes in the thought, “The outcome of education is apparent when careers sharpen your horizons” and we strive every minute working on it. Students’ skills are molded through multifarious training sessions that include technical, aptitude, verbal and soft skill. By understanding their level of grasping and delivering, the students are trained individually, based on their needs. To keep pace with the world, multiplicity of career is essential and that drives us to provide training and guidance for those who aspire to crack the competitive exams. The ambience in Training and Placement department is an inspiration, for its spatial dimensions of Interview cubicles, Group Discussion halls and Guest Lounge that render students a complete professional environment to learn and equip. A team of passionate staff work with a single motive for upgrading the students to the next phase of life by all possible means. Physical Education The concept “Sound Mind in a Sound Body” has motivated us to give equal emphasis to Physical Education along with academic activities. The college having all necessary sports facilities with state of the art technology is available in the campus. The management has provided around 17 acres for sports facilities. The institution has the best teams in Men & Women sections, where the Sports activities are carried out regularly. Physical Education Classes, Training, Coaching Camps and Practice Matches are conducted at periodical intervals and at the time of competitions. The performance of the students has shown an eminent improvement in the field of sports when compared to earlier years. The college has proved to scale lofty heights in the Sports Arena. Ms. K. Divya Prasanna (III B.E – EIE) won bronze medals in the 400m and 800m events. Mr. S. Naveen (III B.E – ECE) secured a bronze in shot put. Mr. H. Muhammed Tariq (III B.E – Mechatronics) earned a silver and a bronze in the 110m hurdles. Mr. R. Sarveshwaran (III B.Tech – Computer Technology) won a silver in the 400m and a bronze in high jump. Mr. M. Nandakkumar (III B.Tech – AIML) bagged a bronze in the 3000m. In team events, the college Men’s Basketball team won the silver medal in the Erode District CM Trophy held at VOC Park Stadium, Erode, on 15th and 16th September 2024. The Women’s Handball team also secured silver in the tournament at Kongu Engineering College, Perundurai, from 11th to 13th September 2024. In chess, held on 11th September 2024 at the same venue, Mr. S. Bavan Kalyan (II B.E – ECE) won the gold medal, while Mr. S. Naveen (II B.Tech – AIML) and Ms. M. Saravanapriya (III B.E – ECE) earned silver medals. The Men’s Hockey team bagged the bronze medal in the tournament held at Kongu Polytechnic College, Seenapuram, on 17th September 2024.
